sloka: शुभ अशुभास्व् अवस्थासु तच् च मे सुव्यवस्थितम् ।न अन्यत्र हि मया शक्या वैदेही परिमार्गितुम् ॥५-११-४२॥
transliteration: śubha aśubhāsv avasthāsu tac ca me suvyavasthitam ।na anyatra hi mayā śakyā vaidehī parimārgitum ॥5-11-42॥

translations.english: 'It is not possible for me to look for Vaidehi elsewhere. During such search operations one always looks for women among women.'
